title: Velvety Kenyan Chicken Stew
description: A light and garlicky Kenyan dish featuring star anise, perfect for a romantic dinner, made in individual mini cocottes for a special touch
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the chicken broth, coconut milk, garlic, star anise, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Divide the chicken and marinade among 4 individual mini cocottes.
Cover the cocottes with lids and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the cocottes from the oven and stir in the chopped cilantro.
Return the cocottes to the oven and bake for an additional 5 minutes.
Remove the cocottes from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
